content.title: Digital Accessibility Progress Report Archive
content.summary: The City of Arvada is implementing a Digital Accessibility Transition Plan (DATP) to enhance the accessibility of its digital assets, with updates provided quarterly. As of December 2025, the city has completed evaluations of its most critical digital assets and is in the process of developing a comprehensive transition plan and making initial improvements, including updates to its website and accessibility reporting methods. Continuous improvement efforts are ongoing, with a cyclical process established to address gaps and meet evolving standards.
content.body:
This page contains archived quarterly status reports made in accordance with HB24-1454.  On December 11, 2025, Arvada published [version 2.1 of its Digital Accessibility Transition Plan (DATP)](/1333), which contained updates that occurred after the last quarterly report through December 2025.  Future updates will be provided in accordance with DATP version 2.1 on a separate webpage at least once per year in December.

**Status Criteria**

- **Evaluating** - comprehensive review of current digital assets to identify accessibility issues and opportunities
- **Planning** - developing a digital accessibility transition plan (priorities, goals, roadmap, resources, timelines)
- **I****nitial improvements / early implementation**- initial changes to address the most critical issues
  - City of Arvada website replaced - ArvadaCO.gov
- **Intermediate progress / ongoing enhancements** - improvements and enhancements across digital platforms
- **Continuous improvement / optimization** - maintained cycle of improvement to address gaps and meet developing standards

## April 2025 Quarterly Report (Q2)

- **Evaluating**- digital asset review completed in priority order
  - Most critical assets (e.g., website, GIS maps, PDFs in active use) - **complete**
  - All other assets -**in progress**
  - Confirming critical asset compliance - **in progress**
- **Planning**- transition plan being developed in stages
  - Transition Plan 1.0**- complete**
  - Partner with a third-party contractor to evaluate progress to date, to continue evaluating, planning, and improvement efforts,  draft Transition Plan 2.0, and continue remediation efforts - **in progress**
- **Initial improvements**- addressing most critical issues
  - Most critical assets - some complete, some in progress
    - Website (including updating the Accessibility page) - **complete**
    - PDFs in active use - **in progress**
    - GIS - **in progress**
    - Third-party websites and services - **in progress**
  - Improved methods of reporting accessibility issues and requesting reasonable accommodations/modification - **complete**
- **Intermediate progress**
  - Evaluation of all digital assets (internal and external) - **in progress**
  - Asset identification, tracking and remediation - **ongoing**
  - Employee training development - **in progress**
  - Policy development and revision - **in progress**
- **Continuous improvement** - cyclical process developed and in place by July 2025
